stem.text: The density of the air in the atmosphere decreases as the height $h$ above the surface of the Earth increases.
Which graph best shows the variation with height $h$ of the pressure $p$ of the air?

A.alt: Graph of p against h: a straight line falls from the p axis to the h axis.

B.alt: Graph of p against h: a curve falls from the p axis to the h axis.

C.alt: Graph of p against h: a curve falls steeply from the p axis and then levels off towards the h axis.

D.alt: Graph of p against h: an S-shaped curve falls from the p axis towards the h axis and levels off.
